# Workspace Configuration
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: invoke the normal build route for a direct delivery request, or invoke the matic route for an open issue labeled `matic`.

## Workspace Name

Lead Hub delivery and matic issue workspace

## Owner

Lead Hub repository team. Item-level ownership is recorded in GitHub and `pm-control/registers/`.

## Primary Outcome

Deliver one approved Lead Hub GitHub issue at a time through the existing Define, Design, Build, Measure, and Learn pipeline, then publish the verified change for review and close the issue after the exact PR merges into `staging`.

## Systems Of Record

| Artifact type | System of record | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Issue outcome and acceptance | GitHub issue in `adventistasia/lead-lab` | The issue body is the request source. Keep the issue number and title in every run reference. |
| Application source and tests | `application/source/` and `application/tests/` | Git branch and commit history are authoritative for code. |
| Project controls | `pm-control/registers/` | Update only relevant records. Do not duplicate register rows in run summaries. |
| Run evidence and handoffs | `application/runs/<run-slug>/` | Working artifacts and stage state for one issue or cycle. |
| Workspace behavior | `workspace/AGENTS.md`, `workspace/CONTEXT.md`, and `workspace/_config/` | Stable routing and quality rules. |
| Review and merge state | GitHub pull request targeting `staging` | Dennis Arquillano (`dennisatssd`) is the required reviewer for matic PRs. |

## External Tools

| Tool | Purpose | When allowed |
|---|---|---|
| `gh` | Read issues, labels, PRs, reviews, checks, and merge state; create the `matic` label; update issue labels and comments; close a merged issue | Read during selection and resume. Mutate only in the declared setup, plan-control, publish, and close stages. |
| `git` | Create the issue branch, inspect changes, commit, and push | Use a clean worktree and branch from `origin/staging`. Never force-push. |
| Project test commands | Verify the changed behavior | Use commands supported by the selected application environment and record their results. |

## Constraints

- The existing `stages/01-define`, `stages/02-design`, `stages/03-build`, `stages/04-measure`, and `stages/05-learn` pipeline remains the build pipeline.
- Matic is invocation-driven. Applying the `matic` label makes an open issue eligible; it does not run a background GitHub Action.
- Only one matic issue is selected per run. The selection stage chooses the simplest eligible issue using the configured score.
- The plan-control stage updates relevant PM Control records before implementation.
- Reconciliation covers every affected carrier, including relevant PM Control records, run evidence, source documentation, tests, and deployment guidance.
- The Measure gate must pass before commit, push, and PR creation.
- Matic PRs target `staging`, request `dennisatssd`, and do not use issue auto-close keywords.
- Issue closure occurs only after the recorded PR is verified as merged into `staging`.
- Production deployment, production data changes, unresolved scope decisions, external-provider selection, privacy approval, and other human-only decisions remain outside label authority.
- Credentials, private keys, tokens, cookies, and real participant data never enter the repository or run evidence.

## Quality Gate

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Passing threshold | 80% minimum; every applicable acceptance criterion must also pass |
| Acceptance rule | `Pass` for every applicable criterion. `Partial`, `Fail`, or unexplained `Not Applicable` does not pass. |
| Failure route | Smallest responsible production stage, then Measure again |
| Blocked or paused run | Record `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` with the exact resume stage and action |
| Final build stages | Measure is the hard gate. Learn produces `what-now.md` only after Measure passes. |
| Publication gate | Publish only after Measure passes, Learn is verified, reconciliation is complete, and the worktree contains only intended changes. |

The detailed policy is `workspace/_config/quality-policy.md`. The run-state schema is `workspace/_config/run-state-template.md`.
